independently_discovered_opportunities: Convert the unified live-operations register from passive truth display into exact receipt validation without allowing automatic mutation.
Make V14 receipt/inventory creation reproducible rather than manually frozen.

product_platform_improvements.problem: v1.7.79 showed unified dependency states but had no exact receipt format or fail-closed promotion preview for new external evidence.
product_platform_improvements.implementation: Added a protected owner-only live-evidence contract and connector with exact source binding, canonical digest, 24-hour evidence window, component-specific required checks, secret/write/activation rejection, and preview-only proposed state. The connector never persists receipts or mutates the register.
product_platform_improvements.before_state: External evidence remained prose or provider-specific and could not be normalized safely.
product_platform_improvements.after_state: Exact nonsecret receipts can be validated and previewed while all state changes, owner GO, deployment, writes, and production activation remain separate and false.
product_platform_improvements.benefit: Roger can review consistent exact evidence before any dependency state changes, without exposing secrets or giving the connector deployment authority.
limitations: No external adapter or live receipt is connected; no promotion is applied.

builder_prompt_system_improvements.problem: V14 inventory and owner-receipt evidence could be validated after creation but lacked one deterministic generation/check command.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.implementation: Added deterministic UTF-8 path-sorted payload inventory generation with exact exclusions plus automated owner receipt inventory hash/count and outer-ZIP self-reference checks.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.before_state: The build had to freeze and verify receipt evidence through separate ad hoc steps.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.after_state: Candidate and final source freezes can use one reproducible generator/check path while detached final identity remains post-package only.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.future_build_benefit: Reduces manual drift and ensures each candidate/final freeze carries reproducible non-self-referential evidence.
limitations: The final outer ZIP SHA-256 and size still cannot be embedded.

reverted_or_rejected_innovation_waves: Automatic state mutation from a submitted receipt was rejected.
Receipt persistence, external provider access, writes, deployment, and production activation were rejected.
lessons_carried_forward: Evidence intake must be exact, current, nonsecret, and component-specific.
Validation and promotion preview are not authorization or state mutation.
V14 payload evidence should be generated reproducibly and outer ZIP identity must remain detached.

prior_limitations_reviewed.disposition: Preserved; connector validates only supplied evidence and performs no external action.
Preserved; no portal receipt is invented.

deferred_opportunities_with_exact_reason: External adapters require exact canonical service identities and protected read-only access.
State application requires a separate audited owner action.
OpenAI live smoke requires dark deployment and protected key entry.
Portal compatibility requires exact current portal artifacts.
next_innovation_opportunities: Read-only GitHub and Render evidence adapters after canonical identities are supplied.
Controlled dark deployment and OpenAI smoke after all prerequisites pass.
